name: Brooklyn (United States)
description: White field charged with the borough seal: a young woman in a blue gown bearing fasces on a blue oval, in a ring reading Een Draght Mackt Maght and Borough of Brooklyn.
history: Brooklyn, coextensive with Kings County, is the most populous of the five boroughs of New York City. The borough flag, based on the flag of the former City of Brooklyn, was adopted on 6 April 1915 and modified on 30 December 1977; its Dutch motto Een Draght Mackt Maght means "In unity there is strength", also expressed by the fasces carried by the figure.
